title: Nickelate superconductors: structure before comparison
summary: Keep infinite-layer films and bilayer Ruddlesden-Popper nickelates distinct, with pressure, reduction, oxygen and strain attached to every claim.

claims.statement: “Nickelate superconductivity” includes distinct structural and preparation routes. Infinite-layer RNiO2 films and bilayer Ruddlesden-Popper La3Ni2O7 crystals differ in layer geometry, oxygen coordination and electronic structure. Their temperatures should not be presented as continuous optimization of one material. Li and colleagues' 2019 discovery and Sun and colleagues' 2023 high-pressure report establish different experimental settings.
claims.conditions: Infinite-layer reduced epitaxial films and high-pressure bilayer crystals are distinct families. The 80 K scale is not an ambient-pressure bulk result; field and strain reports require sample-specific review.
claims.verificationScope: See each source verification label; this ledger does not certify primary findings.

claims.statement: The infinite-layer route uses epitaxial precursors and topotactic reduction. Oxygen stoichiometry, residual apical oxygen, reduction uniformity and the substrate can all matter. A nominal chemical formula does not prove identical electronic states across bulk powders, supported films and membranes. This pilot does not infer a universal exchange energy or a common one-band model from the resemblance of NiO2 and CuO2 planes.

claims.statement: An orbital label such as $d_{x^2-y^2}$ or $d_{z^2}$ identifies part of a model basis; it does not by itself identify the pairing channel. A proposed gap or coupling matrix needs a declared band structure, filling, interaction and structural phase. Similar local configurations can motivate a cuprate analogy, but do not transfer a phase diagram or a numerical pairing scale to nickelates.

claims.statement: Pressure changes can involve structural rearrangement as well as electronic bandwidth. For a bilayer crystal, a model evaluated in one structural phase must be compared with measurements in the same pressure regime. Distinguish calculations suggesting a favorable orbital configuration from observations establishing superconducting signatures.

claims.statement: An 80 K high-pressure bilayer observation is not ambient-pressure bulk superconductivity. Likewise, a strained film and a pressure-treated crystal need not follow an identical structural path. The 2026 film, membrane, oxygen-cycling and magnetic-substitution updates in the pinned chapter require separate primary-text checks. This pilot retains their review debt rather than adding their numbers to a quantitative record.

claims.statement: Compare controlled sample series within a structural family before making cross-family claims. A useful design experiment separates oxygen, strain, interface and carrier changes as far as possible. Negative controls are especially valuable when two substrates both produce compression but only one preparation yields a transition. Such observations constrain a mechanism without proving that one structural variable is sufficient.

claims.statement: Sun2023 reports a resistance onset of 80 K at 18.5 GPa in run 1 without pressure medium. Run 2 uses KBr and shows an onset of 78 K at 18.9 GPa. The 77 K magnetic response is a separate measurement at 25.2 GPa. Residual resistance is explicitly discussed in the methods; these records must not be relabeled as zero resistance.
